data.text: Tech Blog Post: https://t.co/s8r6QWhsGl

Use it in your document workflows, from invoice processing to financial reports and AI agents.
→ 30 file types: PDF, Word, Excel, Parquet, email, images & audio
→ Our cloud, your AWS/Azure, or fully on-prem
→ Console, REST API, CLI, Python & TS SDKs
→ Same API key as Drex

note_tweet.text:
Why this matters for agents: your agent acts on whatever the parser gives it. One wrong number in a table and it approves the wrong invoice.

Drex checks every block against the page before your agent sees it, and if a fix fails, it keeps the original reading, so you never get a blank page.

note_tweet.text:
→ SOTA: #1 among all other decision models (including Jev, Perplexity Decider & Cloudflare Clef)
→ Cost Pareto frontier: per 1M tasks Drex spends ~$102: 1/62 of Haiku ($6,240), 1/15 of GPT6Luna ($1,530) & 1/8th of the next best decision model (~$810).
→ No benchmaxXXXxing: Drex is #1 on the closed evaluations(AA-Paperclip), the model generalizes and is calibrated well.
→ Context length and multimodality: unlike some decision models in the top 5, Drex works with ~8x more context (256k) & is optimized for browser decisions and image classification.

Drex 2.0 ships open weights, and Drex 1.5 routes text at volume.
